name: Joybound People & Pets - Free Vaccination Clinics
description: Free pet vaccines and microchips at clinics across Contra Costa County
fullDescription: Joybound holds free vaccine and microchip clinics at locations throughout Contra Costa County to help ensure all pets have access to essential preventive care.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free rabies and DAPP vaccines for dogs
- Free rabies and FVRCP vaccines for cats
- Free microchips for dogs and cats
- Pet food while supplies last
- Brief health check before vaccination (not a full exam)
- No canine influenza, leptospirosis, or Bordetella vaccines
howToGetIt:
1. Check the Joybound website for upcoming clinic dates and locations
2. Must be a Contra Costa County resident (proof required) and 18 or older
3. Pets must be at least 6 weeks old; dogs on leash, cats in carriers
4. Bring prior vaccine records if you have them
5. Arrive early; service is first come, first served
keywords: Joybound, free vaccinations, rabies, DAPP, DHPP, FVRCP, microchip, Contra Costa, vaccine clinic, pet shots, walk-in
